# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and GPU rendering corrections. The preview line improves transformed geometry, text-atlas selection, displacement filtering and native Vulkan synchronization. Generated LibraryImport calls explicitly use cdecl. Graphite Metal's native minimum rises to iOS and tvOS 15; higher managed framework requirements still apply.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use iOS or tvOS 15 or later for Graphite Metal** — Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native layer; its macOS minimum remains 12. Apps using this backend must meet that minimum as well as any higher managed or framework deployment requirement. The native minimum does not lower those requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157 engine update** — Moves the bundled renderer to milestone 157 while retaining the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.200 package revision accompanies the new milestone; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Raster paths and glyph replay are hardened** — Fixes a convex anti-aliased path heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and convex-path device bounds. Native direct-mask Slug replay gains validation for unsupported fractional replay, deserialization and drawing; Graphite alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback uses the correct stride. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **GPU geometry and text sampling stay aligned** — Corrects oversized square caps on reflected zero-length hairlines, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle radii and strokes, and text-atlas selection under interpolation imprecision. Empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas work, and displacement offsets use full precision to match filter bounds. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Graphite clipping respects render-pass limits** — Corrects clip-key packing and wedge inflation, and includes pending clip draws in pass-capacity checks. A draw whose full clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass is warned about and skipped instead of exceeding capacity. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Vulkan synchronization and cleanup are corrected** — Fixes render-pass pointer initialization and propagates failed synchronous fence waits into native Ganesh submission results. GRContext.Submit remains void, so no managed result is added. A 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay is limited to affected ARM proprietary drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **LibraryImport calls explicitly select cdecl** — Generated interop for SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, SceneGraph, Skottie and Resources now matches the existing DllImport and delegate calling convention. This addresses an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86 without changing public APIs or native exports. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching its existing DllImport and delegate paths without changing public APIs or native exports.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, stale Ganesh atlas work, Graphite clip-capacity accounting and displacement precision. Failed synchronous Vulkan waits now affect native submission results; the managed Submit method remains void.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also adds a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m157, raster and glyph-replay hardening, Graphite clipping and readback fixes, and explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 at the native layer, subject to any higher framework minimum.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
